claim.quote: The T2K experiment observes indications of νμ→νe appearance in data accumulated with 1.43×10²⁰ protons on target. Six events pass all selection criteria at the far detector. ... the probability to observe six or more candidate events is 7×10⁻³, equivalent to 2.5σ significance.

date.note: arXiv v1 submission date; the collaboration's press release (KEK, ICRR, J-PARC) is dated 15 June 2011, one day later. Published as Phys. Rev. Lett. 107, 041801 (2011).

key_value_text.quote: At 90% C.L., the data are consistent with 0.03(0.04)<sin^2 2θ_13< 0.28(0.34) for δCP=0 and a normal (inverted) hierarchy.
key_value_text.value: sin²(2θ13) consistent with 0.03 (0.04) to 0.28 (0.34) at 90% CL for normal (inverted) hierarchy, δCP = 0.

name: T2K indication of electron-neutrino appearance
notes: Classified as a measurement because the collaboration's own wording is 'indications' (title: 'Indication of Electron Neutrino Appearance'); 2.5σ is also below the conventional 3σ evidence threshold (the T2K Nature paper, arXiv:1910.03887, calls a 99.73% (3σ) confidence level 'considered as evidence in the particle physics community').

significance.quote: Under this hypothesis, the probability to observe six or more candidate events is 7$\times10^{-3}$, equivalent to 2.5$σ$ significance.
significance.value: 2.5σ (probability 7×10⁻³ to observe six or more candidate events if sin²2θ13 = 0)

summary.plain: T2K reported 'indications' of muon neutrinos turning into electron neutrinos on their way across Japan: six candidate events at the far detector (Super-Kamiokande) where 1.5 ± 0.3 were expected if the mixing angle θ13 were zero, a 2.5σ result. The paper says more data were required to firmly establish electron-neutrino appearance.
summary.technical: Six events pass all selection criteria at the far detector (Super-Kamiokande) in data corresponding to 1.43×10²⁰ protons on target; the expected number is 1.5 ± 0.3 (syst.) for |Δm²23| = 2.4×10⁻³ eV², sin²2θ23 = 1 and sin²2θ13 = 0. The probability to observe six or more candidate events is 7×10⁻³, equivalent to 2.5σ. At 90% C.L. the data are consistent with 0.03 (0.04) < sin²2θ13 < 0.28 (0.34) for δCP = 0 and a normal (inverted) hierarchy.

title: Indication of Electron Neutrino Appearance from an Accelerator-produced Off-axis Muon Neutrino Beam

why_it_matters.locator: T2K/KEK/ICRR/J-PARC press release of 15 June 2011 (JAEA copy), first paragraph; paper: closing paragraph
why_it_matters.quote: For the first time, it was possible to observe an indication that muon neutrinos are able to transform into electron neutrinos over a distance of 295 km
why_it_matters.value: The collaboration's 15 June 2011 press release says that, for the first time, it was possible to observe an indication that muon neutrinos are able to transform into electron neutrinos over a distance of 295 km; the paper itself concludes that more data are required to firmly establish νe appearance and to better determine the angle θ13.
